description: This PHP source file defines the Translation class within the Opencart admin controller namespace, responsible for managing translation tasks such as generating, writing, and clearing translation files in the Opencart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class for managing translation tasks including generating, writing, and clearing translation files in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of translation tasks for all stores and languages, scheduling translation write tasks.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Creates or updates a JSON translation file for a specific route, store, and language.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated JSON translation files for all stores and languages.
